scope: Player and current player-squad AI only; no enemy actor traversal, order submission or direct control.

source.version: Epic MW5 editor 1.1.390.0e; UE4.26.2; compatible CL14830424
source.interpretation: Generated declarations only. Placeholder return values are not native behavior. Retail availability is unverified.

existingEnvelope.captureOnlyValues: Raw position, native worker/job state and independent player binding need capture-only storage; no existing policy field directly represents all of them. Unknown extra fields survive original files but are not semantically validated by the recording auditor.
existingEnvelope.readFailure: Retain the sample with explicit unknowns and a separate proposed acquisition-failure reason. A tactical rejection is not a reason to delete a capture sample.

projectMetadata.proofNeeded: Creation and teardown binding; no mission-name or level-name reuse as identity.
Increment on each scheduled attempt; record failed attempts or gaps. Do not invent a missing attempt count from elapsed time.
Exact native clock/read route, units, pause behavior, monotonicity and alignment to independent evidence remain unresolved.
Distinct live objects, destruction/reuse and possession behavior; raw pointers, names, display slots and pilot labels are not trusted durable IDs.
Distinguish obtained value, obtained null relationship, invalid object, unsupported read, failed read, not attempted and truncated inventory. These are project statuses, not MW5 enums.

nativeCandidates.captureUse: Bind only to the observed local player controller's current squad.
nativeCandidates.unresolved: Actual owner/world and source-supported local-controller acquisition must be verified.

nativeCandidates.captureUse: Obtain current player-squad AI roster; bound traversal to three AI.
nativeCandidates.unresolved: Ordering, exact count, durable slot identity, atomicity and membership/update timing are undocumented. If more than three are returned, retain count/truncation status; do not silently call the first three a complete roster.

nativeCandidates.captureUse: Check an observed controller against the current squad.
nativeCandidates.unresolved: Not an authority guarantee; sample on the supported game thread.

nativeCandidates.captureUse: Read the current pawn for the player and each observed AI controller.
nativeCandidates.unresolved: A null relationship is distinct from a failed acquisition; cached values cannot survive a switch unchecked.

nativeCandidates.captureUse: Record reciprocal binding using fresh reads.
nativeCandidates.unresolved: Two reads are not proven atomic; ambiguous transitions stay uncertain.

nativeCandidates.captureUse: Record human possession for each observed pawn.
nativeCandidates.unresolved: False does not prove AI ownership. A valid AI controller and reciprocal membership are separate observations.

nativeCandidates.captureUse: Record destruction state before using a binding.
nativeCandidates.unresolved: Not a lifetime lock or a replacement for native validity checks.

nativeCandidates.captureUse: Record per-actor authority as a raw observation.
nativeCandidates.unresolved: Never automatically promote this to snapshot control authority or an enabled command capability.

nativeCandidates.captureUse: Preserve player and AI pawn RootComponent positions in their original coordinate domain.
nativeCandidates.unresolved: Record units/frame as unknown until calibrated. Do not divide by 100, infer meters, velocity, navigation success or stopped motion without supporting evidence.

nativeCandidates.captureUse: Read only for the currently bound, validated AI controller.
nativeCandidates.unresolved: A missing worker does not imply an idle AI. Do not apply this getter to the player controller.

nativeCandidates.captureUse: Compare returned controlled pawn against the current AI pawn.
nativeCandidates.unresolved: Mismatch is explicit evidence of an unresolved binding; do not keep stale worker/job state attached to a new pawn.

nativeCandidates.captureUse: Retain current job object identity or an obtained null relationship.
nativeCandidates.unresolved: Job existence/change is not proof that a human issued an order or that movement occurred.

nativeCandidates.captureUse: Preserve the source enum and separately proved serialization.
nativeCandidates.unresolved: No invented numeric/string mapping; an observed FOLLOW classification alone does not identify its instigator, target or completion.

nativeCandidates.captureUse: Preserve raw state alongside job and worker bindings.
nativeCandidates.unresolved: State transitions must match independent observations and actual native lifetime.

nativeCandidates.captureUse: Only interpret when the current verified job state is FINISHED.
nativeCandidates.unresolved: Otherwise mark not applicable/unknown rather than reading a default as completion. Not proof of completed human intent.

nativeCandidates.captureUse: Preserve pause separately from menu/loading/mission phase.
nativeCandidates.unresolved: Actual world context must be validated; false does not establish an active mission.

nativeCandidates.captureUse: Candidate current-area binding for lifecycle analysis.
nativeCandidates.unresolved: Acquisition/callback/lifetime and allowed game-thread context are not proven.

nativeCandidates.captureUse: Capture only from a valid current area.
nativeCandidates.unresolved: False is not mission readiness; missing area remains unknown.

nativeCandidates.captureUse: Preserve hub distinction independently of loading/pause.
nativeCandidates.unresolved: Client-safe declaration does not prove complete mission lifecycle boundaries.

excludedFromInitialReads: Enemy enumeration, hidden targets, global actor scans and combat-target dereferencing.
Order resolver/posting, job creation, worker cancellation, behavior-tree changes and low-level input.
Physical human-order provenance inferred from job type, job change, player_issued or UI completion.
Health/range/heat normalization or position unit conversion before calibration.
Recipient squad_member_id without verified server-side access; UI slot/display label as a substitute.
Campaign identity, save access or persistent pilot memory.
remainingProducerWork: Supported executable asset authoring and native startup/duplicate/lifecycle proof.
Supported timestamp, object-ID, enum/vector serialization and acquisition-status storage.
Bounded buffering, explicit overflow/missed-attempt records, stopping/export and crash behavior.
Real source-field readback and independent identity/position/lifecycle validation.
No mapping here enables control or certifies a real recording.
